#Source code
```{r source}
source(here("Principal_Genes.R"))
source(here("clSensitivity.R"))
OUT_ROOT   <- here("Bootstrapping")
EXPORT_DIR <- here("Data_Hold", "Bootstrapping")
dir.create(OUT_ROOT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(EXPORT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

#plot appearance
FONT_FAMILY     <- "Arial"
LEGEND_POSITION <- c(1, 0)  #cartesian coordiates. Range from 0 to 1
PLOT_DPI        <- 300
PLOT_WIDTH      <- 5 #inches
PLOT_HEIGHT     <- 4

base_theme <- function(show_legend = FALSE) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      legend.position             = if (show_legend) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside      = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.justification.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.title                = element_blank(),
      legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
    )
}

#Save a plot as TIFF and JPG
save_plot <- function(plot, out_dir, name, suffix,
                      width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT) {
  stem <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, "_", suffix))

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}
```

#PBMCs
##Read in the dataset
```{r read-in-data}

input_file<-paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/PBMCs_Counts.csv")
truth_file<-paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/PBMCs_Labels.csv")
name<-"PBMCs"

count_matrix<-read.csv(input_file, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)
```

##Get principal genes and highlight them on the log_var_mean_plot
```{r principal-genes-running}

row_means<-rowMeans(count_matrix, na.rm=TRUE)
row_var<- apply(count_matrix, 1, var, na.rm=TRUE)

log_var_mean_df<-tibble(
  gene_id=rownames(count_matrix),
  log_mean = log10(row_means +  1),
  log_var = log10(row_var + 1)
)

set.seed(12345)
principal_genes_results <- principalgenes(count_matrix, cut = 1, filters = c("riboFilter", "mtFilter", "gmFilter", "rikFilter", "dotFilter"))
filtered_counts<-principal_genes_results$count_matrix
top_100_genes<-names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:50])
```
##PCA PLOT
```{r plot-pca}
PC1_and_PC2<-as.data.frame(principal_genes_results$rotated_output$x, row.names = colnames(filtered_counts))

#get true labels
full_true_labels<-read.csv(truth_file, check.names = FALSE)
full_true_labels$numeric_labels<-as.numeric(factor(
  full_true_labels$label,
  levels = unique(full_true_labels$label)
))
true_labels<-subset(full_true_labels, cell %in% colnames(filtered_counts))
PC1_and_PC2$labels<-true_labels$label
PC1_and_PC2$numeric_labels <- as.numeric(factor(
  PC1_and_PC2$labels,
  levels = unique(true_labels$label)
))
```

##BUILD CUMULATIVE GENE LISTS BY THRESHOLD
```{r build-cumulative-gene-lists}

thresholds <- seq(10, 50, by = 2)

selectedGeneList <- list()
current_gene_list <- list()
currentpropsum <- 0
threshold_index <- 1

for(i in seq_along(principal_genes_results$top_genes)){
  
  current_gene_list <- append(current_gene_list, principal_genes_results$top_genes[i])
  
  currentpropsum <- currentpropsum + principal_genes_results$top_genes[i] * 100
  
  if(currentpropsum >= thresholds[threshold_index]){
    selectedGeneList[[threshold_index]] <- current_gene_list
    
    print(paste("Threshold", thresholds[threshold_index], "reached at index", i))
    
    threshold_index <- threshold_index + 1
    
    if(threshold_index > length(thresholds)){
      break
    }
  }
}

num_genes <- list()
for (i in seq_along(selectedGeneList)){
  num_genes[[i]]<-length(selectedGeneList[[i]])
}
num_genes<-unlist(num_genes)

true_labels_vector <- setNames(PC1_and_PC2$numeric_labels, row.names(PC1_and_PC2))
k_cls <- max(true_labels_vector)
```

##BUILD HVG GENE LISTS (SEURAT), MATCHED TO THE SAME THRESHOLDS AS PG
```{r build-hvg-gene-lists}
library(Seurat)

seuratObject <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(count_matrix))
Idents(seuratObject) <- "All_Cells"
norm_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(seuratObject)
seuratObject <- FindVariableFeatures(norm_seuratObject, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = length(rownames(count_matrix))) #dispersion value = log(variance/mean)


scored_hvg <- seuratObject[["RNA"]]@meta.data$vf_disp_data_mvp.dispersion
names(scored_hvg) <- rownames(count_matrix)
scored_hvg[is.na(scored_hvg)] <- 0
scored_hvg <- sort(decreasing = TRUE, scored_hvg)
HVGs <- names(scored_hvg) #descending-order HVG gene names, aligned with count_matrix rownames

# Build HVG gene lists sized to match the number of genes selected by PG at each threshold
HVGGeneList <- list()
for (j in seq_along(num_genes)) {
  HVGGeneList[[j]] <- HVGs[1:num_genes[j]]
}
```

##BUILD UNION (PG + HVG) GENE LISTS AT EACH THRESHOLD
```{r build-union-gene-lists}
UnionGeneList <- list()
for (j in seq_along(selectedGeneList)) {
  UnionGeneList[[j]] <- unique(union(names(selectedGeneList[[j]]), HVGs[1:num_genes[j]]))
}
union_num_genes <- as.integer(sapply(UnionGeneList, length))
```

##SK_MEANS CLUSTERING ON RANDOM 80% CELL SUBSETS FOR EACH GENE-SELECTION METHOD
```{r sk-means-subsampled-accuracy}
n_subsets <- 5
subset_frac <- 0.8
seeds <- c(12345, 54672, 44182, 72198, 98230)

all_cells <- colnames(count_matrix)
subset_size <- floor(subset_frac * length(all_cells))

# Matrices to hold accuracy: rows = subsets, columns = threshold levels
accuracy_matrix_pg    <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_subsets, ncol = length(selectedGeneList))
accuracy_matrix_hvg   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_subsets, ncol = length(HVGGeneList))
accuracy_matrix_union <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_subsets, ncol = length(UnionGeneList))

for (r in 1:n_subsets){
  set.seed(seeds[r])
  cell_subset <- sample(all_cells, subset_size)
  sub_true_labels <- true_labels_vector[cell_subset]

  print(paste("subset:", r))
  for (j in seq_along(selectedGeneList)){
    # Principal Genes
    submat_pg <- count_matrix[names(selectedGeneList[[j]]), cell_subset]
    set.seed(seeds[r])
    sub_cluster_pg <- skmeans(x = t(log2(submat_pg + 1)), k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    sub_sens_pg <- clustSensitivity(sub_cluster_pg, sub_true_labels, as.character(1:k_cls))
    accuracy_matrix_pg[r, j] <- as.numeric(sub_sens_pg[1, 2])

    # Seurat HVGs
    submat_hvg <- count_matrix[HVGGeneList[[j]], cell_subset]
    set.seed(seeds[r])
    sub_cluster_hvg <- skmeans(x = t(log2(submat_hvg + 1)), k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    sub_sens_hvg <- clustSensitivity(sub_cluster_hvg, sub_true_labels, as.character(1:k_cls))
    accuracy_matrix_hvg[r, j] <- as.numeric(sub_sens_hvg[1, 2])

    # PG / HVG Union
    submat_union <- count_matrix[UnionGeneList[[j]], cell_subset]
    set.seed(seeds[r])
    sub_cluster_union <- skmeans(x = t(log2(submat_union + 1)), k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    sub_sens_union <- clustSensitivity(sub_cluster_union, sub_true_labels, as.character(1:k_cls))
    accuracy_matrix_union[r, j] <- as.numeric(sub_sens_union[1, 2])

    print(paste0(j, "th threshold clustering done"))
  }
}

summarize_accuracy <- function(accuracy_matrix, n_subsets) {
  mean_accuracy   <- colMeans(accuracy_matrix)
  sd_accuracy     <- apply(accuracy_matrix, 2, sd)
  se_accuracy     <- sd_accuracy / sqrt(n_subsets)
  margin_of_error <- qt(0.975, df = n_subsets - 1) * se_accuracy
  data.frame(
    mean_accuracy   = as.numeric(mean_accuracy),
    sd_accuracy     = as.numeric(sd_accuracy),
    margin_of_error = as.numeric(margin_of_error),
    ci_lower        = as.numeric(mean_accuracy - margin_of_error),
    ci_upper        = as.numeric(mean_accuracy + margin_of_error)
  )
}

pg_summary    <- summarize_accuracy(accuracy_matrix_pg, n_subsets)
hvg_summary   <- summarize_accuracy(accuracy_matrix_hvg, n_subsets)
union_summary <- summarize_accuracy(accuracy_matrix_union, n_subsets)

points_sk <- data.frame(
  thresholds        = as.numeric(thresholds),
  num_genes         = as.integer(num_genes),
  union_num_genes   = as.integer(union_num_genes),
  PG_mean           = pg_summary$mean_accuracy,
  PG_ci_lower       = pg_summary$ci_lower,
  PG_ci_upper       = pg_summary$ci_upper,
  HVG_mean          = hvg_summary$mean_accuracy,
  HVG_ci_lower      = hvg_summary$ci_lower,
  HVG_ci_upper      = hvg_summary$ci_upper,
  Union_mean        = union_summary$mean_accuracy,
  Union_ci_lower    = union_summary$ci_lower,
  Union_ci_upper    = union_summary$ci_upper
)

# "PLOT CLUSTERING RESULTS COMPARING HVGS AND CUMULATIVE SCORE"
plot_df1 <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(thresholds = points_sk$thresholds, num_genes = points_sk$num_genes,
             union_num_genes = points_sk$union_num_genes,
             mean_accuracy = points_sk$PG_mean, ci_lower = points_sk$PG_ci_lower,
             ci_upper = points_sk$PG_ci_upper, metric = "PG_sensitivity"),
  data.frame(thresholds = points_sk$thresholds, num_genes = points_sk$num_genes,
             union_num_genes = points_sk$union_num_genes,
             mean_accuracy = points_sk$HVG_mean, ci_lower = points_sk$HVG_ci_lower,
             ci_upper = points_sk$HVG_ci_upper, metric = "HVG_sensitivity"),
  data.frame(thresholds = points_sk$thresholds, num_genes = points_sk$num_genes,
             union_num_genes = points_sk$union_num_genes,
             mean_accuracy = points_sk$Union_mean, ci_lower = points_sk$Union_ci_lower,
             ci_upper = points_sk$Union_ci_upper, metric = "PG_HVG_Union")
)

plot_df1$metric <- factor(plot_df1$metric,
                           levels = c("PG_sensitivity", "HVG_sensitivity", "PG_HVG_Union"))
plot_df1$label_val <- NA
plot_df1$label_val[plot_df1$metric == "PG_sensitivity"] <- plot_df1$num_genes[plot_df1$metric == "PG_sensitivity"]
plot_df1$label_val[plot_df1$metric == "PG_HVG_Union"] <- plot_df1$union_num_genes[plot_df1$metric == "PG_HVG_Union"]

write.csv(plot_df1, file = file.path(paste0(EXPORT_DIR, "/", name, "_PG_HVG_Union_CumulativeScore_Subsampled_Accuracy.csv")))
```

##PLOT MEAN CLUSTERING SENSITIVITY VS CUMULATIVE SCORE WITH 95% CI (PG, HVG, UNION)
```{r plot-subsampled-accuracy}
p<-ggplot(plot_df1, aes(x = thresholds, y = mean_accuracy, color = metric)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.5) +

  # PG labels
  geom_text(
    data = subset(plot_df1, metric == "PG_sensitivity"),
    aes(label = label_val),
    color = "#1BB7D8", vjust = +2, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +

  # Union labels
  geom_text(
    data = subset(plot_df1, metric == "PG_HVG_Union"),
    aes(label = label_val),
    color = "#2C9F45", vjust = -2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
              check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    method.args = list(span = 1, degree = 1, surface = "direct"),
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cumulative GPS (%)", y = "Mean Clustering Sensitivity", title = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("PG_sensitivity", "HVG_sensitivity", "PG_HVG_Union"),
    values = c(
      "PG_sensitivity"  = "#1BB7D8",
      "HVG_sensitivity" = "#E55B1E",
      "PG_HVG_Union"    = "#2C9F45"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "PG_sensitivity"  = "Principal Genes",
      "HVG_sensitivity" = "Seurat's HVG",
      "PG_HVG_Union"    = "HVG_PG_Union"
    )
  ) +
  base_theme(show_legend = FALSE)
p
save_plot(p, OUT_ROOT, name, "PG_HVG_Union_CumulativeScore_Subsampled_Sensitivity")
```
